sloka: ते शराः शिखिसङ्काशा निपतन्तः समाहिताः।राक्षसान् दारयामासुर्वज्राणीव महागिरीन् ।। ६.९०.४ ।।
transliteration: te śarāḥ śikhisaṅkāśā nipatantaḥ samāhitāḥ।rākṣasān dārayāmāsurvajrāṇīva mahāgirīn ।। 6.90.4 ।।

translations.english: Those burning arrows falling on Rakshasas touched the Rakshasas and split them like thunderbolt splitting mountains.
